title: Privacy Policy
intro: {{appName}} helps you compare grocery prices at stores near you. This policy explains what information the app handles, why, and the choices you have. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: {{appName}} ("we", "us") provides the {{appName}} mobile app. If you have a question about this policy or your information, contact us at {{supportEmail}}.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We only handle the information needed to run the app:
bullets: Account details: your email address and password when you sign up. Passwords are handled by our authentication provider and are stored in hashed form; we never see your password in readable form. If you sign in with Google or Apple, we receive the name and email address they share with us.
Profile details: your name, if you add it when you sign up or in Profile, and your phone number, only if you add it in Profile.

Location: the postal area you pick (the first three characters of a postal code, such as M5V) or, if you tap "Use my current location", a one time reading of your phone's location taken only while the app is open. We never track your location in the background. The coordinates are rounded to about 1 km and stored on your device. When you view nearby stores or run a comparison, the rounded coordinates are sent to our servers so we can find the closest stores. We do not keep a location history on our servers, although the rounded coordinates can appear in routine server logs.

Basket contents: the products and quantities you add. Your basket and saved baskets are kept on your device. When you run a comparison, the basket contents are sent to our servers to calculate prices, and are not stored afterward.
Technical information: like most services, our servers and hosting providers record standard log data such as IP address, date and time, the type of request, and device or app version.

sections.heading: 3. What we do not collect
paragraphs: We do not show advertising, we do not use analytics or crash reporting tools that track you, and we do not access your contacts, photos, microphone, or camera. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: 4. How we use information
bullets: To create and secure your account and sign you in.
To find stores near you and calculate which store has the lowest total for your basket.
To show your name in the app and keep your preferences.
To respond to support requests, keep the service secure, prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 5. Who we share information with
paragraphs: We share information only with service providers that help us run the app, and only as needed:
bullets: Supabase, which provides sign in and our database.
Our cloud hosting provider, which runs the servers that calculate store and price results.
Google or Apple, only if you choose to sign in with them.
Authorities or other parties when the law requires it, or to protect the rights and safety of users and the service.

sections.heading: 6. Retailers
paragraphs: We do not share your personal information with grocery retailers. Store and price information shown in the app comes from the websites of the retailers shown and is not personal information about you. {{appName}} is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any retailer.

sections.heading: 7. How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep your account information while your account is active. You can delete your account at any time in the app under Profile, then Account & Privacy, then Delete Account. Deleting your account permanently removes it from our authentication provider and any basket records tied to it on our servers. Information saved only on your device is removed when you uninstall the app. Logging out clears your current basket, location and preferences; your saved baskets stay on the device for your account and are removed when you delete your account or when a different account signs in on that device. Routine server logs and provider backups are deleted on the provider's normal schedule.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: Information sent between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit. We limit access to the systems that hold your information. No online service can guarantee perfect security, so please use a strong, unique password.

sections.heading: 9. Where information is processed
paragraphs: Our providers may process information in Canada and in other countries, including the United States. Those countries may have different privacy laws than Canada.

sections.heading: 10. Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Under Canadian privacy law you can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, ask us to delete it, and withdraw your consent to our handling of it. You can change your name and phone number in Profile, turn off location by not setting one or by disabling location permission in your device settings, and delete your account in the app. For any other request, contact {{supportEmail}}. You also have the right to complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

sections.heading: 11. Children
paragraphs: {{appName}} is not intended for children under {{minimumAge}}. We do not knowingly collect information from children under {{minimumAge}}. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed. If a change is significant, we will tell you in the app.
